semiconductor_relevance: High — Hajime Corporation provides essential materials and equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in PCB and FPC manufacturing.
summary: Hajime Corporation specializes in advanced materials and technologies for the electronic industry, focusing on products for PCB and Flexible PCB manufacturing. They also represent various industrial adhesive tapes and inspection equipment tailored for semiconductor production processes.
capabilities: UV dicing tape for semiconductor applications
Inspection equipment for PCB and FPC manufacturing
Image measuring equipment under the Unifocus brand

regional_presence.Taiwan: Hajime Corporation is based in Taipei, Taiwan, where it primarily sells UV dicing tape and other materials for the semiconductor industry.
